title: Stolypin, the Dumas and Reform to 1914
reason: The only discrepancy is stating that one landlord vote equalled 543 peasant votes rather than 260 peasant votes (with 543 being workers), which at GCSE is impressive supporting detail showing the franchise was heavily rigged rather than a mark-losing error.
